notes: V30.37 turns the hierarchical estimator into a causal feedback system. Multi-view RGB remains the primary geometric scaffold; relative Alva increments use independent translation/rotation switch variables while the absolute Alva pose is only a weak gauge prior. Depth calibration is observability-gated, globally monotone and reweighted by the previous reliability E-step. Residual fields are classified into pose/global-depth/local-depth/match/occlusion/dynamic hypotheses, confidence is maintained at frame/region/pixel levels, and dense Deep samples are kept candidate until leave-one-view-out independent evidence confirms them. Committed geometry is fused in local submaps and late loop closure moves submaps rigidly through a submap pose graph instead of re-integrating a global TSDF.
